easy: The bad feeling you get when you know you did something wrong.

easy: The thinking you do to make a choice.

ex.en: Deciding what to eat for dinner took us a long time.
ex.ko: 저녁에 뭘 먹을지 정하는 데 오래 걸렸다.

easy: A person who keeps someone or something safe from attack.

ex.en: The knight was a brave defender of the castle.
ex.ko: 그 기사는 성을 용감하게 지키는 수호자였다.

easy: Having to do with teeth.

ex.en: I use dental floss every night.
ex.ko: 나는 매일 밤 치실을 쓴다.

easy: Having to do with the work of tooth doctors.

ex.en: I have a dental check-up next week.
ex.ko: 나는 다음 주에 치과 검진이 있다.

easy: Having to do with keeping peace between countries.

ex.en: The ambassador took a diplomatic trip to meet leaders.
ex.ko: 대사는 지도자들을 만나러 외교 출장을 갔다.

easy: Careful about what you say so no one gets upset.

ex.en: She gave a diplomatic answer so her friends would not fight.
ex.ko: 그녀는 친구들이 다투지 않도록 요령 있게 대답했다.

easy: A music instrument that you hit with sticks.

ex.en: I play the drum in the school band.
ex.ko: 나는 학교 밴드에서 드럼을 친다.

easy: The sound that a drum makes.

ex.en: We heard the drum from the parade far away.
ex.ko: 우리는 멀리서 퍼레이드의 북소리를 들었다.

easy: Having to do with a newspaper article that gives opinions.

ex.en: My dad reads the editorial page every morning.
ex.ko: 아빠는 매일 아침 신문의 사설 면을 읽으신다.

easy: Having to do with the person who checks and picks stories to print.

ex.en: Her editorial job is to check every story before it is printed.
ex.ko: 그녀의 편집 일은 인쇄하기 전에 모든 기사를 확인하는 것이다.

easy: A newspaper article that tells what the writer thinks.

ex.en: The editorial said our town needs a new park.
ex.ko: 그 사설은 우리 동네에 새 공원이 필요하다고 했다.

easy: Fun to watch or do.

ex.en: The magic show was very entertaining.
ex.ko: 마술 쇼는 아주 재미있었다.
